attribution.title: Raadhuisstraat 52, Amsterdam: corner house with a round oriel and a stepped stone-edged gable (BAG 1902; rijksmonument 518499)
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012172357 (CC0), with the front gable redrawn to the photographed outline: the round corner oriel with its corbel and balcony railing, the stepped stone gable edge with pinnacles and three arched lights, the canted oriel on a corbel, the sash windows with stone lintels, the green-glazed ground arches and courses, the shopfront with its lettered fascia and the canal front's hooded windows and balconettes, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
